meta.title: Fees
meta.description: A Ponte Deal Room costs $79 USD for 30 calendar days and includes five active private counterparty branches. Additional branches are $15 USD each, capped at $199 USD per room per 30-day period.

pricing.title: One opportunity. Multiple confidential negotiations. Five languages.
pricing.intro: Ponte is free for finding opportunities and establishing credible interest. You pay when counterparties move from interest into controlled transaction execution, and there is one thing to pay for.

product.name: Ponte Deal Room
product.body: One structured commercial opportunity, with confidential parallel counterparty negotiations beneath it. Controlled admission, an agreed procedure, evidence, clarifications, blockers and decisions, durable multilingual records, and a read-only history after the room closes.
product.cta: See how a Deal Room works

formula.heading: How the price is worked out
formula.included: $79 USD covers 30 calendar days and up to five concurrently active private counterparty branches.
formula.additional: Each additional concurrently active branch costs $15 USD for the rest of that 30-day period.
formula.cap: The most a Master Deal Room can cost is $199 USD per 30-day period, however many branches are running.
formula.worked: So five branches cost $79 USD. Seven cost $109 USD. Thirteen or more cost $199 USD.

languages.heading: Five languages, included
languages.body: English, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Modern Standard Arabic. There is no multilingual plan, translation surcharge, per-word fee or separate language tier.

free.heading: What carries no charge
free.body: Browsing, publishing opportunities, preparing a Deal Room, inviting counterparties, receiving and accepting invitations, participants, advisers and specialists, documents, translations, and read-only history. Verifying your own business is free. An invitation that is unanswered, declined or expired never generates a charge.

never.heading: What Ponte does not charge for
never.body: There are no memberships, plans, subscriptions, credit packs, listing fees, per-seat charges, per-document or per-message charges, commissions, success fees or percentages of your transaction. Ponte is paid for controlled transaction infrastructure, not for acting as a broker or claiming part of your trade.

check.heading: Checking a counterparty
check.body: A private check on another company is charged separately from the Deal Room. The cost is always shown before a check runs.

expiry.heading: When a period ends
expiry.body: Nothing is deleted and no participant is removed. The room and its branches become read-only, everyone keeps access to their record, and starting a new 30-day period is priced from the branches you choose to resume. A room with nothing to resume stays readable without payment.

pricing.footnote: Prices are in US dollars and exclude any tax that applies where you are. Ponte does not convert currencies.
